title: Routing chain list
acceptance: Walk order is preserved exactly as received; the component never re-sorts.
An ineligible row names the single responsible factor, not a generic label.
Exactly one row is marked as the one that will serve, in text as well as colour.
No colour literal appears anywhere; every colour is a CSS custom property reference.
Rows already present do not replay their entrance animation on a parent refresh.
Blocking-factor selection and the serving-row predicate are exported pure functions with tests.
